## Comprehensive Implementation Plan: Street-to-Suite (生存与职场)

---

### 1. FILE STRUCTURE

The game uses a minimal three-file architecture that can be bundled into a single HTML for deployment. During development, use the split form; for production, inline everything into `index.html`.

```
project-root/
  index.html          # Main entry point. In production, all CSS/JS inlined.
  src/
    index.html        # Development version - thin shell
    css/
      style.css       # All styles: layout, components, theme, responsive
    js/
      main.js         # Entry point, initialization, game loop dispatch
      data/
        jobs.js       # All street-level job definitions (15+)
        goods.js      # Trade goods definitions + base prices
        locations.js  # Location definitions
        corp.js       # Corporate ranks, departments, events
        news.js       # News event templates
        npcs.js       # NPC definitions
        skills.js     # Skill/certificate definitions
        items.js      # Equipment and item definitions
      core/
        state.js      # GameState class - single source of truth
        save.js       # localStorage save/load/auto-save logic
        time.js       # Time system: daily slots, quarterly progression
        events.js     # Random event engine, news generation
      phase1/
        jobs.js       # Job execution logic, pay calculation, stat effects
        trade.js      # Buy/sell goods, price fluctuation
        needs.js      # Hunger/fatigue/hygiene decay, status effects
        hustle.js     # Street-specific mini-game logic
      phase2/
        corp_ops.js   # Corporate actions (projects, networking, learning)
        perf.js       # Performance review calculation and grading
        promo.js      # Promotion checking and rank advancement
        team.js       # Team management (P7+)
        stock.js      # Stock trading system
      ui/
        render.js     # Main render dispatch
        panels.js     # Stat panel, inventory panel, time panel
        cards.js      # Action card rendering
        log.js        # Message log / narrative text
        modal.js      # Modal dialogs (confirmations, choices)
        corp_ui.js    # Corporate phase specific UI
        tutorial.js   # Onboarding / tutorial overlays
        responsive.js # Mobile layout adjustments
```

**Bundle strategy**: A build script concatenates and inlines CSS/JS into a single `dist/index.html` for deployment. The plan below assumes you write each module separately first, then bundle.

### 2. DATA MODEL (Complete GameState)

Below is the complete `GameState` object. Every property is defined with its type, default, and range.

```javascript
// ====== GAME STATE (single source of truth) ======
const GameState = {
  // --- Meta ---
  version: '1.0.0',
  createdAt: null,           // timestamp
  lastPlayedAt: null,        // timestamp
  playTime: 0,               // seconds played

  // --- Player Identity ---
  player: {
    name: '无名',            // string
    gender: 'male',          // 'male' | 'female'
    age: 18,                  // 18-60 (integer)
    birthday: { month: 1, day: 1 }, // for age-up logic

    // PHASE 1: 4 Core Attributes (0-100, start: 15-25 each)
    physique: 20,             // 体质 - physical strength/stamina
    intelligence: 18,         // 智力 - IQ, learning speed
    agility: 22,              // 敏捷 - hand-eye coordination, speed
    mental: 25,               // 心智 - mental resilience, stress tolerance

    // PHASE 2: 7 Corporate Stats (0-100, initialized on corp entry)
    corporate: {
      hair: 100,              // 发量 - overwork reduces this
      dignity: 60,            // 尊严 - eroded by bad management
      upwardMgmt: 20,         // 向上管理 - managing up skill
      kpi: 20,                // 产出 - raw output
      ability: 30,            // 能力 - technical/domain ability
      risk: 0,                // 埋雷 - accumulated risk (0-100, dangerous!)
      popularity: 30,         // 人缘 - peer relationships
    },

    // --- Phase Tracking ---
    phase: 'street',          // 'street' | 'corporate'
    day: 1,                   // total days played (increments each full day)
    corpYear: 0,              // years in corporate (0 = just joined)
    corpQuarter: 1,           // 1-4 current quarter of the year
    timeSlot: 'morning',      // 'morning' | 'afternoon' | 'evening'
  },

  // --- Resources ---
  resources: {
    cash: 200,                // Cash on hand (yuan)
    bankBalance: 0,           // Savings account
    debt: 0,                  // Total outstanding loan
    loanPrincipal: 0,         // Original loan amount (for interest calc)
    loanDay: 0,               // Day loan was taken
    dailyInterest: 0.003,     // 0.3% daily interest
  },

  // --- Needs (0-100, decay over time) ---
  needs: {
    hunger: 60,               // 0 = starving (debuffs), 100 = full
    fatigue: 20,              // 0 = rested, 100 = exhausted (forced rest)
    hygiene: 70,              // 0 = filthy (social penalty), 100 = clean
    happiness: 50,            // 0 = depressed, 100 = euphoric
  },

  // --- Derived Status ---
  status: {
    health: 100,              // 0-100, hits 0 = game over
    fame: 0,                  // 0-100, affects some job availability
    emotionalState: 'stable', // 'stable' | 'happy' | 'sad' | 'angry' | 'stressed' | 'depressed'
    drunk: false,             // drunkenness flag
    sick: false,              // illness flag
    injured: false,           // injury flag (from manual labor accidents)
  },

  // --- Skills & Certificates ---
  skills: {
    // Each skill: { level: 0-100, xp: 0-1000 }
    cooking:    { level: 0, xp: 0 },
    repair:     { level: 0, xp: 0 },
    coding:     { level: 0, xp: 0 },
    english:    { level: 0, xp: 0 },
    driving:    { level: 0, xp: 0 },
    sales:      { level: 0, xp: 0 },
    management: { level: 0, xp: 0 },
    accounting: { level: 0, xp: 0 },
    electrician:{ level: 0, xp: 0 },
    welding:    { level: 0, xp: 0 },
  },
  certificates: [],           // Array of cert IDs earned
  education: 0,               // 0-100, proxy for "years of schooling equivalent"

  // --- Inventory ---
  inventory: {
    items: [],                // [{ id, qty, condition (0-100) }]
    capacity: 20,             // max item slots (can be expanded)
    equipment: {              // Equipped gear
      head: null,             // item id or null
      body: null,
      feet: null,
      hand: null,
      accessory: null,
    },
  },

  // --- Relationships ---
  relationships: {},          // { npcId: { affinity: -100-100, favors: 0 } }

  // --- Trade System ---
  trade: {
    currentLocation: 'slum',  // location key
    goodsPrices: {},          // { locationKey: { goodId: price } }
    priceTrends: {},          // { goodId: 'up'|'down'|'stable' }
    lastPriceUpdate: 0,       // day of last price recalculation
  },

  // --- Loan / Debt ---
  loans: [],                  // [{ lender, amount, dayTaken, interestRate, dueDay }]

  // --- Employment ---
  employment: {
    currentJob: null,         // job id if actively employed at a fixed job
    jobStartDay: 0,
    completedShifts: {},      // { jobId: count }
    totalEarned: 0,           // lifetime earnings tracker
  },

  // --- Corporate (Phase 2) ---
  corporate: {
    company: null,            // company object
    rank: 'P5',              // 'P5' | 'P6' | 'P7' | 'P8' | 'P9' | 'P10'
    department: 'engineering',// department key
    joinedDay: 0,            // day when player entered corp phase
    perfHistory: [],          // [{ year, quarter, grade, salary }]
    consecutiveCPerfs: 0,     // consecutive C grades (3 = fired)
    quarterlyActions: 3,      // actions per quarter (increases at P7+)
    actionsUsed: 0,           // actions used this quarter

    // Team (P7+)
    team: [],                 // [{ name, role, skill, loyalty, productivity }]
    teamSize: 0,

    // Stock Holdings
    stocks: [],               // [{ symbol, name, shares, buyPrice }]
    stockMarket: {},          // { symbol: { price, history, volatility } }

    // Special Projects
    projects: [],             // [{ name, progress, impact, deadline }]
    completedProjects: [],

    // Goals for current quarter
    quarterGoals: {
      kpiTarget: 0,
      abilityTarget: 0,
      projectName: null,
    },
  },

  // --- Game State Flags ---
  flags: {
    tutorialCompleted: false,
    hasBeenToBank: false,
    hasTakenLoan: false,
    hasVended: false,
    hasDoneFactory: false,
    hasJoinedCorp: false,
    gameOver: false,
    victory: false,
    victoryType: null,        // 'p10' | 'money' | 'company'
    gameOverReason: null,
    ageThisYear: false,       // has aged this year
    seenNewsToday: [],        // news IDs shown today
  },

  // --- News / Events ---
  activeNews: [],             // currently active news affecting prices
  newsHistory: [],            // [{ day, headline, effect }]
  queuedEvents: [],           // pending random events

  // --- Log ---
  messageLog: [],             // [{ turn, text, type: 'info'|'success'|'danger'|'event' }]
}
```

### 7. KEY ALGORITHMS

#### 7A. Price Fluctuation Algorithm

```javascript
function updatePrices(state) {
  // Called every 3 days
  for (const locationKey of Object.keys(LOCATIONS)) {
    for (const good of GOODS) {
      let price = good.basePrice;

      // 1. Location multiplier (0.6 - 1.8)
      const locationMultiplier = LOCATION_PRICE_MULTIPLIERS[locationKey][good.id];
      price *= locationMultiplier;

      // 2. Random daily fluctuation (+/- 15%)
      const fluctuation = 0.85 + Math.random() * 0.3;
      price *= fluctuation;

      // 3. Active news effect
      for (const news of state.activeNews) {
        const effect = news.effects[good.id];
        if (effect && effect.type === 'multiply') {
          price *= effect.value;
        }
      }

      // 4. Supply/demand memory (mean reversion)
      const currentPrice = state.trade.goodsPrices[locationKey]?.[good.id];
      if (currentPrice) {
        const deviation = (currentPrice - price) / price;
        // 10% mean reversion per update
        price = price + (currentPrice - price) * 0.1;
        // Clamp deviation to +/- 30% from current
        price = clamp(currentPrice * 0.7, currentPrice * 1.3, price);
      }

      // 5. Round to 2 decimal places
      price = Math.round(price * 100) / 100;
      price = clamp(good.basePrice * 0.3, good.basePrice * 5.0, price);

      state.trade.goodsPrices[locationKey][good.id] = price;
    }
  }
  state.trade.lastPriceUpdate = state.player.day;

  // Generate price trend indicators for UI
  for (const goodId of GOODS.map(g => g.id)) {
    const pricesAcrossLocations = Object.keys(LOCATIONS).map(loc =>
      state.trade.goodsPrices[loc][goodId]
    );
    const min = Math.min(...pricesAcrossLocations);
    const max = Math.max(...pricesAcrossLocations);
    const spread = ((max - min) / min) * 100;
    state.trade.priceTrends[goodId] = {
      minLocation: Object.keys(LOCATIONS)[pricesAcrossLocations.indexOf(min)],
      maxLocation: Object.keys(LOCATIONS)[pricesAcrossLocations.indexOf(max)],
      spreadPercent: Math.round(spread),
      trend: spread > 30 ? 'volatile' : 'stable',
    };
  }
}

function clamp(min, max, value) {
  return Math.max(min, Math.min(max, value));
}

// Location price multipliers (sample matrix)
const LOCATION_PRICE_MULTIPLIERS = {
  slum:            { water: 0.9, snacks: 0.85, noodles: 0.8, scrap_metal: 1.6, scrap_paper: 1.5, scrap_plastic: 1.5, daily_use: 0.7 },
  wholesaleMarket: { water: 0.6, snacks: 0.55, noodles: 0.5, cigarettes: 0.7, beer: 0.7, clothing: 0.6, electronics: 0.55, fruits: 0.5, vegetables: 0.5 },
  commercialDist:  { water: 1.3, snacks: 1.4, noodles: 1.3, cigarettes: 1.4, beer: 1.5, clothing: 1.5, electronics: 1.6, fruits: 1.6, vegetables: 1.5 },
  school:          { water: 0.8, snacks: 0.9, noodles: 0.9, fruits: 1.0, vegetables: 1.0 },
  factoryZone:     { water: 1.1, snacks: 1.0, noodles: 1.0, cigarettes: 1.2, beer: 1.2 },
  // All others default to 1.0
```

#### 7B. Performance Review Scoring

```javascript
function calculatePerfScore(state) {
  const c = state.player.corporate;

  // Base score (0-100)
  let score = 0;

  // Weighted contribution:
  score += c.kpi * 0.35;           // KPI is most important
  score += c.ability * 0.25;       // Technical ability
  score += c.upwardMgmt * 0.20;    // Managing up
  score += c.popularity * 0.15;    // Peer relationships
  if (state.corporate.team.length > 0) {
    // Team management contribution (P7+)
    const teamAvgProd = state.corporate.team.reduce((s,m) => s + m.productivity, 0) / state.corporate.team.length;
    score += teamAvgProd * 0.05;    // 5% from team performance
  }

  // --- Penalties ---
  // Hair loss penalty (hair < 30 => -15, hair < 50 => -5)
  if (c.hair < 30) score -= 15;
  else if (c.hair < 50) score -= 5;

  // Dignity penalty
  if (c.dignity < 20) score -= 20;
  else if (c.dignity < 40) score -= 8;

  // Risk penalty
  if (c.risk > 70) score -= 15;
  else if (c.risk > 50) score -= 5;

  // --- Bonuses ---
  // High dignity bonus
  if (c.dignity > 80) score += 5;
  // High popularity bonus
  if (c.popularity > 80) score += 5;

  // Clamp and add small random variance (+/- 5%)
  score = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, score));
  score += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 10;
  score = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, score));

  return Math.round(score);
}

function assignGrade(score, state) {
  // Grades are NOT fixed thresholds; they use relative ranking
  // against a simulated peer group for realism
  const peerScores = generatePeerScores(state);
  const allScores = [...peerScores, score];
  allScores.sort((a, b) => b - a);

  const rank = allScores.indexOf(score);
  const percentile = rank / allScores.length;

  let grade;
  if (percentile < 0.05) grade = 'S+';    // Top 5%
  else if (percentile < 0.15) grade = 'S';  // Top 5-15%
  else if (percentile < 0.50) grade = 'A';  // Top 15-50%
  else if (percentile < 0.85) grade = 'B';  // Top 50-85%
  else grade = 'C';                         // Bottom 15%

  // Floor: if score < 25, force C regardless of peer comparison
  if (score < 25) grade = 'C';

  return { grade, score, peerScores };
}

function generatePeerScores(state) {
  // Simulate 20 "coworkers" with scores clustered around the player's level
  const base = calculatePerfScore(state);
  const peers = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
    let peerScore = base + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 40;  // +/- 20 spread
    peerScore = Math.max(5, Math.min(100, peerScore));
    peers.push(Math.round(peerScore));
  }
  return peers;
}
```

#### 7C. Promotion Check

```javascript
function checkPromotion(state) {
  const rank = state.player.corporate.rank;
  if (rank === 'P10') return null; // Already max

  const rankData = CORP_RANKS[rank];
  const reqs = rankData.promotionReqs;
  const corp = state.corporate;

  // Check age requirement
  if (state.player.age < rankData.minAge) return null;

  // Check ability
  if (state.player.corporate.ability < reqs.minAbility) return null;

  // Check team size (P7+)
  if (reqs.teamSize > 0 && corp.team.length < reqs.teamSize) return null;

  // Check performance history
  if (corp.perfHistory.length < reqs.minReviews) return null;

  // Check required review grades (look at most recent reviews)
  const recentReviews = corp.perfHistory.slice(-reqs.minReviews);
  const requiredReviewCount = reqs.requiredReviews.length;

  // Count how many required grades are satisfied
  let satisfiedCount = 0;
  const remainingRequired = [...reqs.requiredReviews];
  for (const review of recentReviews) {
    const idx = remainingRequired.indexOf(review.grade);
    if (idx !== -1) {
      remainingRequired.splice(idx, 1);
      satisfiedCount++;
    }
  }

  if (satisfiedCount < requiredReviewCount) return null;

  // --- P10 special check ---
  if (rank === 'P9') {
    // Need board approval: simulated as special event
    if (!state.corporate.specialProjectCompleted) return null;
    // Board vote: 70% base chance + modifiers
    let chance = 0.7;
    chance += state.player.corporate.popularity * 0.002;   // +0.2% per popularity point
    chance += state.player.corporate.upwardMgmt * 0.002;
    if (state.corporate.stocks.length > 0) chance += 0.05; // shareholders look favorable
    if (Math.random() > chance) return 'P10_pending';      // need to try again next quarter
  }

  return rankData.next; // Return the next rank to promote to
}

function applyPromotion(state, newRank) {
  const oldRank = state.player.corporate.rank;
  state.player.corporate.rank = newRank;
  // Log promotion event
  state.messageLog.push({
    turn: state.player.day,
    text: `🎉 恭喜！你从 ${CORP_RANKS[oldRank].name} 晋升为 ${CORP_RANKS[newRank].name}！`,
    type: 'success',
  });
  // Salary adjustment happens next quarter
  // Stat bonuses on promotion
  state.player.corporate.ability += 5;
  state.player.corporate.hair += 10;   // Promotion gives motivation/hair recovery
  state.player.corporate.dignity += 10;
}
```

#### 7E. Emotional State Determination

```javascript
function determineEmotionalState(state) {
  const p = state.player;
  const n = state.needs;
  let score = 0;

  // Base from happiness
  score += n.happiness * 0.4;

  // Fatigue impact
  if (n.fatigue > 80) score -= 20;
  else if (n.fatigue > 60) score -= 10;
  else if (n.fatigue < 20) score += 5;

  // Hunger impact
  if (n.hunger < 20) score -= 15;
  else if (n.hunger < 40) score -= 5;

  // Hygiene impact
  if (n.hygiene < 20) score -= 10;
  else if (n.hygiene < 40) score -= 5;

  // Mental attribute impact
  score += (p.mental - 50) * 0.2;

  // Health impact
  if (p.status.health < 30) score -= 15;

  // Determine state
  if (score < 20) return 'depressed';
  if (score < 35) return 'sad';
  if (score < 45) return 'stressed';
  if (score > 75) return 'happy';
  if (score > 65) state.angryCheck = (state.angryCheck || 0) + 1;
  if (state.angryCheck > 3) return 'angry';
  return 'stable';
}
```

### 9. CRITICAL ARCHITECTURAL DECISIONS

**1. Immutable state updates**: Every mutation to `GameState` goes through `updateState(path, value)` which returns a new state object (or uses deep clone). This makes save/restore trivial and prevents stale references.

**2. On-demand rendering**: The UI does NOT use a framework. Instead, use a `render()` function that reads the current state and does targeted DOM updates. Use a dirty-flag pattern: each subsystem sets a flag when state changes meaningful for display, and the render loop checks flags at 16ms intervals.

**3. Separation of data and logic**: All game data (jobs, goods, locations) lives in `data/` files as plain JS objects. Logic modules import data and state, produce effects. This makes it easy to add new content without touching logic.

**4. Phase as a state machine**: `GameState.player.phase` acts as the state machine selector. The main loop dispatches to `phase1/` or `phase2/` engines based on this flag. The transition is a discrete event (the interview mini-game).

**5. No external dependencies**: Vanilla JS only. No React, no jQuery, no build tools for development. The "bundle" step is a simple Python script that concatenates and inlines files.

### 10. POTENTIAL CHALLENGES AND MITIGATIONS

| Challenge | Mitigation |
|-----------|------------|
| State becomes very large/complex | Use modular GameState with clear sections. Each module only touches its subsection. |
| Price fluctuation math produces unrealistic prices | Use basePrice * locationMultiplier * randomFluctuation * newsEffect, then clamp to [0.3x, 5x] of base. |
| Corporate phase feels disconnected from street phase | Keep emotional state system active in both phases. Use the same message log. Transition has a proper story event. |
| Too many stats to display | Collapse secondary stats into tooltips. Show only the most important 5-7 stats in sidebar at a time. |
| Perf reviews feel random/unfair | Show the player the breakdown of their score. Show peer comparison in a bar chart. Always show grade thresholds. |
| Mobile layout too cramped | Phase-specific layouts: street phase uses tabbed interface for mobile; corporate phase uses stacked cards. |
| Player hoards cash, never transitions | Add soft pressure: street jobs pay less as you age. NPCs suggest "getting a real job". Increase loan interest over time. |
